text:
Simon: FYI the 3am nightly perf job flagged a regression on small-batch (seq128, batch<=8). Median token latency up ~15% vs baseline. CI: https://ci.redwood/jobs/nightly-small-batch/987 :rotating_light:
runtime-bot: alert: nightly-perf-regression detected (job=nightly-small-batch, metric=median_token_latency, delta=+15%)
Amanda: oncall here — picking this up. Simon, can you paste the failing run commit/sha and any quick diffs?
James: could be related to the kernel reorder in PR #4127, but that's a guess. We should bisect before reverting.
Simon: quick snapshot from the CI artifact (truncated):
```diff
- median_token_latency: 12.5ms
+ median_token_latency: 14.4ms
- p95_latency: 30.2ms
+ p95_latency: 34.9ms
commit: 3f8a2d4 -> 7b9c1e0 (PR 4127 merged last night)
```
Lisa: KV cache hit rates in the artifact look unchanged, so batching/cache unlikely. Kernel launch times look suspicious.
Simon: also saw this in the logs: `kernel_launch_time` median jumped. Snippet:
```json
{"kernel_launch_time_ms": {"baseline": 0.9, "current": 2.1}}
```
Amanda: creating ENG ticket and kicking off a bisect job. ENG-7892 created and labels added infra/perf nightly-ci. Link: https://redwood/issue/ENG-7892
runtime-bot: bisect job queued: https://ci.redwood/jobs/bisect/555 (estimate ~30m)
James: I'll add a quick profiling run to the bisect: run with `ENV=PROFILE=1 ./bench/runner --seq 128 --batch 4` and capture nvprof traces. That should confirm kernel-side regression.
Simon: I'll run that on my dedicated pool in ~20m and drop traces here. If it repros locally I'll also try `--no-quant` to rule out quantization path changes.
Lisa: if bisect points to PR 4127 we should push a targeted kernel fix; reverting risks reintroducing previous perf regressions.
Amanda: agreed. I'll coordinate rollback as a last resort and notify SRE if we need emergency capacity changes. Keep updates in this thread. :eyes:
